rows.title: Lamont to propose $200-per-person CT tax rebate
rows.standfirst: The $500 million rebate technically would be paid out of CT’s sales tax receipts and would not force deep cuts to the state budget.

rows.title: Tax cuts rank high on CT legislative agenda for 2026
rows.standfirst: Tax-cutting proposals and gubernatorial election years traditionally go hand in hand in CT, and 2026, so far, has been no exception.

rows.title: Lamont to unveil $28.7 billion CT budget to lawmakers
rows.standfirst: Gov. Ned Lamont will propose a $28.7 billion budget that features a $200-per-person tax rebate and preserves modest funding for K-12 schools.

rows.title: Lamont challenges legislators to reform ‘earmarks’
rows.standfirst: Lamont proposed trimming earmarks in all but three areas, and increasing transparency, amid a probe into the Blue Hills Civic Association.

rows.title: How much does your town get in Lamont’s budget plan for FY27?
rows.standfirst: Gov. Ned Lamont’s spending plan maintains a $95 million increase for K-12 schools that lawmakers began this fiscal year.

rows.title: Lamont’s budget: A big rebate; most of the rest stays the course
rows.standfirst: Lamont’s budget cuts earmarks, or funds for legislators’ smaller projects, amid an ongoing probe into the Blue Hills Civic Association.

rows.title: Lawmakers spar with Lamont administration over tax rebate plan
rows.standfirst: The CT tax rebate debate began Friday in the General Assembly, with Republicans in a key committee pushing back on Lamont’s plan.

rows.title: Senate GOP pitches deep cuts to CT tax and electric bills
rows.standfirst: Senate Republicans say Connecticut can afford far more than the one-time $500 million tax rebate Gov. Ned Lamont pitched last week.

rows.title: Gov. Lamont’s tax rebate: What you need to know
rows.standfirst: Gov. Ned Lamont wants to give a $500 million tax rebate to roughly 2.2 million people. Here’s how to find out if you would share in it.

rows.title: CT judges seek 4.6% pay hike next year to close wage gaps
rows.standfirst: Legislative leaders praised CT’s judges and their performance, but they also noted lawmakers are swamped with funding requests this year.

rows.title: Lamont and CT lawmakers disagreeing on tax cuts, so far
rows.standfirst: Gov. Lamont wants to give a $200 tax rebate, but lawmakers from both parties want repeating tax cuts of far more than $200.

rows.title: Nor’easter snow strains CT’s road salt supplies
rows.standfirst: The CT DOT, which procures road salt for many cities and towns, could not provide more to assist in the immediate clean-up of the nor’easter.
